title: Combining Like Terms
_notes: Source of truth for the 0.4 practice set. "expr" answers are checked at several values of the variables, and the page also requires a finished form (no parentheses, no two like terms). "multi" uses check like:<term> (option is one term with the same variable part) and equals:<expr>; "match" uses check "equal". Chips: DIST yellow, COMBINE green. See docs/exercises.md.

exercises.prompt: Select all the like terms of 5x.
exercises.read: Which of these are like terms of five x? Choose all that apply.
exercises.say_answer: Two of them are like terms of five x: negative three x and x. Like terms have exactly the same variable part. The number in front does not matter.

options.why: Same variable part, x. The coefficient doesn't matter.
options.say: Negative three x. The variable part is x, the same as in five x. A like term.

options.why: x is 1x: same variable part as 5x.
options.say: x. That is one x, with the same variable part. A like term.

options.why: x² is not x: the exponents are different.
options.say: Five x squared. Same number, but x squared is not x. The exponents are different, so it is not a like term.

options.why: Different variable. The same coefficient doesn't make terms alike.
options.say: Five y. It has the same number, but a different variable. Not a like term.

options.why: 5 is a constant; it has no x at all.
options.say: Five. This is a constant with no variable, so it is not like five x.

say: Both terms have x, so they are like terms. Add the coefficients: seven plus four is eleven, so eleven x.

wrong.why: Adding like terms keeps the variable part: x stays x; it does not become x².
wrong.say: turn the x into x squared

wrong.why: Combining adds the coefficients; it doesn't multiply them.
wrong.say: multiply the coefficients

wrong.why: The x is still there: 7 x's and 4 x's make 11 x's.
wrong.say: drop the variable

say: These are like terms. Nine minus twelve is negative three, so negative three y.

wrong.why: 9 − 12 is negative: you lost the sign.
wrong.say: lose the minus sign

wrong.why: The minus sign means subtract 12y, not add it.
wrong.say: add the twelve instead of subtracting it

wrong.why: The answer still has y: it is −3 y's.
wrong.say: drop the variable

exercises.read: Six a plus five minus two a plus three.
say: The a terms are six a and negative two a. Six minus two is four, so four a.
The constants are five and three. Five plus three is eight. A terms and constants are not alike, so we stop.

wrong.why: Constants have no a, so they can't join the a terms.
wrong.say: add every number into one a term

wrong.why: The minus sign belongs to 2a: 6a − 2a = 4a.
wrong.say: forget the minus in front of two a

wrong.why: 5 and 3 are both added: 5 + 3 = 8.
wrong.say: subtract the three instead of adding it

exercises.prompt: Select all the like terms of 4xy.
exercises.read: Which of these are like terms of four x y? Choose all that apply.
exercises.say_answer: Two of them are like terms of four x y: negative two x y, and y x. Each has one x and one y, and the order of a product doesn't matter.

options.say: Negative two x y. Same variable part, x y. A like term.

options.why: yx = xy, because multiplication is commutative.
options.say: y x. Multiplication is commutative, so y x is x y. A like term, with coefficient one.

options.why: It has x but no y. The whole variable part must match.
options.say: Four x. It has x, but no y. Not a like term.

options.why: x² y is not x y: the power of x is different.
options.say: Four x squared y. The x is squared here, so the variable part is different. Not a like term.

options.why: It has y but no x.
options.say: Nine y. It has y, but no x. Not a like term.

exercises.read: Three x squared plus five x minus x squared plus two x.
exercises.a_read: two x squared plus seven x
say: The x squared terms are three x squared and negative x squared, which has a coefficient of negative one. Three minus one is two, so two x squared.
The x terms are five x and two x. Five plus two is seven, so seven x. x squared and x are not like terms, so we stop here.

wrong.why: x² and x are not like terms; they stay separate.
wrong.say: combine the x squared terms with the x terms

wrong.why: The minus sign belongs to x²: 3x² − x² = 2x².
wrong.say: forget the minus in front of x squared
wrong.read: four x squared plus seven x

wrong.why: −x² is an x² term; it can't be combined with the x terms.
wrong.say: treat negative x squared as negative x
wrong.read: three x squared plus six x

exercises.read: Three times the quantity x plus four, plus two x.
say: Distribute first. Three times x is three x, and three times four is twelve.
Now combine the x terms. Three x plus two x is five x. Twelve has no like term, so it stays.

wrong.why: The 3 multiplies both terms inside: 3 · 4 = 12.
wrong.say: multiply only the x by three

wrong.why: 3(x + 4) means multiply by 3, not add 3.
wrong.say: add three and four instead of multiplying

wrong.why: 12 is a constant; it can't join the x terms.
wrong.say: combine the twelve with the x terms

exercises.prompt: Match each expression with its simplified form.
exercises.read: Match each expression with its simplified form.
exercises.say_answer: Every expression now has its simplified form. Adding like terms adds coefficients; multiplying x by x makes x squared.

pairs.say: Two x plus three x minus x. Two plus three minus one is four, so four x.

pairs.why: One x plus one x is two x.
pairs.say: x plus x. One plus one is two, so two x.

pairs.why: Multiplying x by x gives x², not 2x.
pairs.say: x times x. This is multiplication, not addition, so it is x squared.
Five y minus five y plus y. Five minus five plus one is one, so just y.

exercises.read: Five times the quantity two a minus one, minus three times the quantity a minus two.
say: Distribute both parts. Five times the quantity two a minus one is ten a minus five. Negative three times the quantity a minus two is negative three a plus six.
Combine like terms. Ten a minus three a is seven a. Negative five plus six is one.

wrong.why: (−3) · (−2) is +6: negative times negative is positive.
wrong.say: make negative three times negative two negative six

wrong.why: −3 must multiply the −2 as well, not just the a.
wrong.say: multiply only the a by negative three

wrong.why: The minus belongs to 3a: 10a − 3a = 7a.
wrong.say: drop the minus in front of three a

exercises.read: The opposite of the quantity four x minus seven, plus six x minus nine.
say: The minus in front means negative one times the quantity. It changes both signs: negative four x plus seven.
Now combine. Negative four x plus six x is two x. Seven minus nine is negative two.

wrong.why: The minus in front changes the sign of −7 too: it becomes +7.
wrong.say: change only the sign of four x

wrong.why: The minus in front changes both signs inside.
wrong.say: ignore the minus in front

wrong.why: The minus in front changes the sign of 4x too: it becomes −4x.
wrong.say: change only the sign of the seven

exercises.prompt: Select all the expressions equal to 3x + 2.
exercises.read: Which of these are equal to three x plus two? Choose all that apply.
exercises.say_answer: Three of them are equal to three x plus two: x plus two x plus two, two plus three x, and four x minus x plus one plus one. Combine like terms in each one and compare.

options.say: x plus two x plus two. x plus two x is three x, so this is three x plus two. Equal.

options.why: Same terms in another order: addition is commutative.
options.say: Two plus three x. The same terms in another order. Equal.
Four x minus x plus one plus one. Four x minus x is three x, and one plus one is two. Equal.

options.why: 3x and 2 are not like terms; they can't become 5x.
options.say: Five x. This adds the two to the x term, but a constant is not like an x term. Not equal.
Three times the quantity x plus two. That is three x plus six. Not equal.
Three x squared plus two. x squared is not x. Not equal.

exercises.read: Two x squared plus three x minus five x squared plus x minus four.
exercises.a_read: negative three x squared plus four x minus four
say: Start with the x squared terms: two x squared and negative five x squared. Two minus five is negative three.
Next the x terms: three x and x, which is one x. Three plus one is four. Negative four has no like term, so it stays.

wrong.why: The minus belongs to 5x²: 2x² − 5x² = −3x².
wrong.say: forget the minus on five x squared
wrong.read: seven x squared plus four x minus four

wrong.why: x has a hidden coefficient of 1: 3x + x = 4x.
wrong.say: skip the hidden one in front of x
wrong.read: negative three x squared plus three x minus four

wrong.why: x² terms and x terms are not alike; keep them apart.
wrong.say: combine the x squared terms with the x terms

exercises.read: Three times the quantity two y minus one, minus the quantity y plus five, plus four times the quantity y minus two.
say: Distribute all three parts. Three times the quantity two y minus one is six y minus three. The minus sign changes both signs: negative y minus five. And four times the quantity y minus two is four y minus eight.
Collect the y terms: six y minus y plus four y. Six minus one plus four is nine, so nine y.
Now the constants: negative three, minus five, minus eight. Together that is negative sixteen.

wrong.why: The minus in front of (y + 5) changes the 5 too: it is −5.
wrong.say: keep the five positive after the minus sign

wrong.why: The minus in front of (y + 5) changes the y too: it is −y.
wrong.say: change only the sign of the five

wrong.why: 4 multiplies both terms in (y − 2): 4 · (−2) = −8.
wrong.say: multiply only the y by four

exercises.read: Two times the quantity x squared minus three x, minus x times the quantity x minus four, plus five.
exercises.a_read: x squared minus two x plus five
say: Distribute. Two times the quantity x squared minus three x is two x squared minus six x. Negative x times the quantity x minus four is negative x squared plus four x.
The x squared terms: two x squared minus x squared is x squared.
The x terms: negative six x plus four x is negative two x. Five stays as it is.

wrong.why: (−x) · (−4) is +4x: negative times negative is positive.
wrong.say: make negative x times negative four negative
wrong.read: x squared minus ten x plus five

wrong.why: The minus in front of x(x − 4) changes both of its terms.
wrong.say: ignore the minus in front of x times the quantity
wrong.read: three x squared minus ten x plus five

wrong.why: (−x) · x is −x², so 2x² − x² = x².
wrong.say: lose the sign of negative x times x
wrong.read: three x squared minus two x plus five
